flows: Location: Enter: the field opens holding the stored value; Enter closes it, and the new value shows, is the server's, reaches a second socket, and survives a reload
Location: Escape: Escape closes the field on the stored value, and nothing is written (the server's version and a second socket's copy stay)
Location: leaving the field: leaving the field commits what was typed: it shows, is the server's, and reaches a second socket
Location: leaving it untouched: leaving an untouched field closes it and writes nothing
Weather: pick from the chip: the chip opens its closed set (not set | clear | fog | rain | storm | snow); a pick writes it, shows it, and reaches a second socket

a place: a location with a value is drawn under the world: a location given an Inventory value (lantern) is drawn as its own group (location:c7_gate_cellar, headed "C7 gate Cellar") under the world's four slots, on both sockets; cleared, it goes
